title: `ml_get: invalid lnum` when redrawing with visual selection active

labels.name: has:vim-patch
labels.description: issue is fixed in vim and patch needs to be ported

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.7.0-dev+833-g74a90cf09

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

Yes

### Operating system/version

Fedora 35

### Terminal name/version

GNOME Terminal v3.42.2

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

Source

### How to reproduce the issue

```vim
call setline(1, ['a', 'b'])
call feedkeys("G\<C-V>", 'xnt')
lua vim.api.nvim_buf_call(vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true), function() vim.cmd "redraw" end)
```

### Expected behavior

No error.

### Actual behavior

```
E5108: Error executing lua [string ":lua"]:1: Error executing lua: [string ":lua"]:1: Vim(redraw):E315: ml_get: invalid lnum: 2
stack traceback:
	[C]: in function 'cmd'
	[string ":lua"]:1: in function <[string ":lua"]:1>
	[C]: in function 'nvim_buf_call'
	[string ":lua"]:1: in main chunk
stack traceback:
	[C]: in function 'nvim_buf_call'
	[string ":lua"]:1: in main chunk
```

It's possible there's an equivalent repro for Vim, or a vim-patch that solves this issue, but I haven't found one yet.
I'll try to look into this later; posting this so it's logged.
